newsitem.title: USA: FP&L St Lucie nuke to reduce output to Weds.
newsitem.headline: FP&L St Lucie nuke to reduce output to Weds.

text.p: Florida Power & Light Co will operate its 839 megawatt St Lucie nuclear power unit 2 at a reduced level through early Wednesday for scheduled testing and inspections, a company spokeswoman said.

The Hutchinson Island, Fla. plant could be taken to as low as 70 percent of capacity through Tuesday and then would likely be returned to full power Wednesday, company spokeswoman Janice Brady said Tuesday.
The unit was operating at 80 percent of capacity as of early Tuesday, according to a plant status report from the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.
"We are going to do some testing of valves on the turbine, and some inspections of our condenser," Brady said.

Separately, Florida Power's 666 megawatt Turkey Point nuclear unit 3 was shutting down Tuesday after two of the reactor's control rods dropped. The Florida City, Fla. unit was expected to be out of service for two to three days.
Florida Power is a subsidiary of FP&L Group.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
